tasks.question: Using Novartis' reported 2025 gross Scope 1, gross market-based Scope 2 and gross Scope 3 GHG emissions, calculate their sum and compare it with the disclosed total gross market-based GHG emissions, retaining the reported thousand-tCO2e unit and explaining any exact or rounding difference.

What near- and long-term GHG targets does Novartis report, including base year, Scope 1 and 2 and Scope 3 reduction percentages and years, the Scope 3 categories in the near-term focus, SBTi validation, treatment of residual emissions, and reported 2025 progress?

What 2025 water-quality targets and results does Novartis report for its own manufacturing sites and high-risk suppliers, and what boundary rules, exemptions, assumptions and supplier-list qualifications define these indicators?

What 2025 workforce health and safety metrics does Novartis report for HSE-system coverage, lost-time injury and illness rates, total recordable case rates and fatalities across employees, third-party personnel and contractors, including the stated rate denominator and site boundary?

What 2025 access-to-medicines results does Novartis report for patients reached and countries with products sold, and what portfolio, sales, calculation and geographic boundary qualifications define those two indicators?

What sustainability information is covered by Novartis' independent limited-assurance report, what conclusion and professional standards are stated, and what earlier-period, other-information, GHG-credit and forward-looking exclusions or limitations apply?
